title: Live MODFLOW6 root-active single-window coupling feasibility under governed accuracy
pass_evidence: prescribed-root accepted-trajectory coverage complete and MODFLOW tangent endpoint authoritative
predictor temporal indicator below governed limit
coupled fixed point satisfied governed head residual and frozen flux criterion in two iterations
MODFLOW timestep, SWAP state and interface ledger each committed exactly once

interpretation_amendment.observed_before_change: The first implementation required every intermediate prepared-solve iterate to report modflow_converged=true even when the coupled fixed-point residuals had not yet converged.
interpretation_amendment.correction: Treat intermediate prepared solves as admissible fixed-point iterates when the prepared-solve API returns OK and all values are finite; require the coupled fixed point to satisfy the preregistered head and flux convergence gates within six iterations.
interpretation_amendment.rationale: The preregistration governs convergence of the coupled fixed point, not convergence classification of each intermediate iterate before the boundary response is updated.

downstream: ACC02-F2 multiple consecutive live root-active coupling windows under the same frozen accuracy contract.
